purpose: Teach: 単体/序盤/ワイルド/くわえ/不都合/幾度/当り/きまっ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューは単体でも人気よ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the new menu item is doing well on its own.
lines.style: Warm affirmation with a soft lift at the end. Gentle eye contact. The tone of someone who's been watching and is pleased with what they see.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、開店序盤はお客様少なめね、メイちゃん
lines.en: It was pretty quiet in those first hours after opening.
lines.style: Observational, matter-of-fact. A small pause before speaking, like she's mentally reviewing the morning. Calm, not disappointed—just noting what happened.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新作のワイルドな盛り付け、いいわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That bold plating on the new item really works.
lines.style: Appreciative murmur. Light warmth in the voice. Nodding slightly—genuinely impressed by the visual impact.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様がストローをくわえて飲んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of our customers was actually drinking it through a straw the whole time.
lines.style: Amused, small laugh underneath. A detail she noticed and is sharing like a small gift. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、不都合のないシフトを組もうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's make sure the schedule works for both of us.
lines.style: Practical and kind at once. No fuss, but genuine care beneath it. The straightforward gentleness of someone thinking ahead.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、幾度も試作した甲斐があったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: All those test batches were worth it.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction. A breath of relief on the opening. Not bragging—just acknowledging the work paid off. Steady, grounded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の予想が当りそうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: It looks like your prediction was right.
lines.style: Soft affirmation. Gentle tease underneath—she called it. No triumphalism, just warm acknowledgment of intuition proven right.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューの発表日もきまったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: We've set a date for the launch announcement.
lines.style: Bright with anticipation. Forward momentum in the pace. Not rushed—eager but grounded. The voice of someone who can see the finish line and is ready.
